text: {"lessons":["My account fell 4% in one month, so I should keep the portfolio’s overall risk and diversification in view rather than react to every short-term move.","I went several periods without trading; that can be sensible, but I should still review my holdings periodically and act when they no longer fit my plan.","Selling Stock B at a gain felt rewarding, but I should not sell simply to lock in a gain or hold a losing position just to avoid the pain of realizing a loss."]}
